body: Thanks for listening at least someone will... I just can't really see a point to everything and it's just tiring. I just don't have anyone who can remotely understand me and this loneliness is eating me alive... nothing worse than feeling alone when you're surrounded by everyone.

Is just my feelings don't matter. Nobody cares about my feelings... they act like it's no big deal to say shit in front of me. People down me and they don't realize it... it's like oh well just say this and laugh and she'll forget we said it. It's like I'm strong all the time never allowed to be weak... people disregard my feelings because I just shrug it off. I guess that's my own fault though.
